messages.text: U.S. 10-YEAR TREASURY YIELD ROSE TO 5%, THE FIRST TIME AT THAT LEVEL IN NEARLY THREE YEARS

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada is ready to negotiate with the United States and expects an agreement could be reached at some point.

The Details:

•	Tax policy: Carney said more tax-competitiveness measures are coming soon.

•	U.S. talks: Carney said a mutually advantageous deal between Canada and the United States is possible.

•	Negotiating stance: Carney welcomed President Trump’s comments that a deal could come soon and said U.S. officials may better understand Canada’s red lines.

•	European ties: Carney said Canada and the European Union have an opportunity to build prosperity and may see enhanced labor mobility from their partnership.

Anthropic is still likely to pursue a 2026 initial public offering, multiple sources told Axios, despite heightened debate over AI safety and model-release pacing.

The Details:

•	Listing venue: Business Insider reported that Anthropic has decided to list on the Nasdaq.

•	Safety commitments: Anthropic pledged third-party model evaluations and suggested pacing that could slow releases, according to the supplied report.

•	Rival timeline: OpenAI was leaning toward a 2027 listing and still appeared to be doing so, Axios reported.

•	Potential change: A major unwinding of the AI trade could alter Anthropic’s expected course, according to the report.
